claims.quote: Persistent focal epileptiform discharges were present on serial EEGs in 20/37 patients (54%).
Mean age at seizure onset was 3.7 years (median with interquartile range [IQR] 1.3-4.9).

Sodium channel blockers showed notable efficacy.
Highest drug response rates were seen with lacosamide, followed by clobazam, carbamazepine/oxcarbazepine, and lamotrigine.
Epilepsy surgery (n = 8) led to seizure freedom in four and significant reduction in one case.
Epilepsy surgery was beneficial even in MRI-negative cases.
